claim.en: The Zbudza municipal website says mayor Matej Havrilla was born in 1970 in Michalovce and studied at the Faculty of Mechanical Engineering of TU Košice.
claim.sk: Web obce Zbudza uvádza, že starosta Matej Havrilla sa narodil v roku 1970 v Michalovciach a vyštudoval Strojnícku fakultu TU Košice.
